The '''Stonecutter Outpost''' is a mining site located at the eastern coast of the [[Avium Savannah]], just south-east of the [[Locus Oasis]] in the continent of [[Varlamore]]. [[Metla]], a dwarven stonemason, sells high-level Construction materials in [[Stonecutter Supplies|her store]], similar to the [[Keldagrim Stonemason]]. [[Avinia]] can be seen wandering around the mining site.

This [[List of mines|mine]] is one of many where three iron rocks can be mined without moving, thus ideal for [[Iron rocks#Power-mining Locations|power-mining]].

South of the outpost is a [[Cave Entrance (Stonecutter Outpost)|cave entrance]], where players can attempt to enter. However, the cave is currently inaccessible due to a large amount of rocks blocking the way.

There is a [[Rowboat (amenity)|rowboat]] east of the outpost, which can be unlocked by building the utility at the destination, [[Vatrachos Island]], with 10 [[swamp paste]] and 8 [[Camphor plank|camphor planks]]. This requires 46 [[Sailing]], 50 [[Construction]], and completion of the quest [[Children of the Sun]].
